original_value: Economic growth in many countries is increasingly driven by successful startups that operate as online platforms. These success stories have motivated us to define and classify various online platforms according to their business models. This study discusses strategic and operational issues arising from five types of online platforms (resource sharing, matching, crowdsourcing, review, and crowdfunding) and presents some research opportunities for operations management scholars to explore.

result.paraphrase: Many countries’ economic growth is increasingly propelled by successful startups that function as online platforms. Inspired by these success stories, we define and categorize various online platforms by business model. This study examines the strategic and operational challenges associated with five platform types—resource sharing, matching, crowdsourcing, review, and crowdfunding—and highlights research opportunities for operations management scholars.
